sloka: अहो दशरथो राजा निस्नेहः स्वसुत प्रियम् ।प्रजानामनघम् रामम् परित्यक्तुमिहेच्छति ॥२-४९-८॥
transliteration: aho daśaratho rājā nisnehaḥ svasuta priyam ।prajānāmanagham rāmam parityaktumihecchati ॥2-49-8॥

translations.english: Alas, the loveless king Dasaratha now intends to abandon his own sinless son Rama who is dear to the subjects.
